failures.criterion: Spec item 1 (an event fetches again the reads whose answer it can change): a document's open 'Referenced by' panel shows a new citation
failures.evidence: Red test 'document panel: a new comment citing a project document shows in its open Referenced by panel within 2 s' in packages/dispatch/e2e/refresh-freshness.e2e.ts (commit f454e5b1ef47). It fails at head on chromium and iphone: the panel still reads 'Referenced by (1) ... First cite of dispatch://CORE/artifact/runbook.' 2 s after a second comment cites the document. It passes at base 16e4bb0f758e, which refreshed every ['references'] panel. Cause found by reading: event-refresh.ts appendDocumentPanel (177-193) reaches only the anchored or owning document, changedReferenceTargets (771-827) handles only issue and ask targets, and the server leaves document targets out of references_changed (refs.go CountedChanges). Command: cd packages/dispatch && DATABASE_URL=<own db> bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --project=iphone e2e/refresh-freshness.e2e.ts -g 'document panel'.

failures.criterion: Spec item 4 (an event during a fetch fetches it again once that fetch settles, so the answer composed after the event is the one shown)
failures.evidence: Red test 'reference: a title written while the reference's read is in flight shows after leaving the page and coming back' in refresh-freshness.e2e.ts (f454e5b1ef47). It fails at head on chromium and iphone, and on 2 of 2 repeats: back on the page, the reference still shows 'Target v2' while the server holds 'Target v3', and no further summary read is sent. Also red unit test 'a read left inside the second after a fetch an event landed in still owes that event when it is rendered again' in packages/dispatch/web/src/api/query-refresh.test.ts (commit cbcf7310c171): isInvalidated is false where true is expected (`cd packages/dispatch && bun test web/src/api/query-refresh.test.ts`). Cause found by reading: query-refresh.ts drive() (167-172) drops the debt for a query that went inactive during the wait, after the settled fetch cleared its stale flag. A summary read has staleTime Infinity, so it stays wrong until the next event for that issue.

failures.criterion: Spec item 4 and item 2: a conditional refresh decided while a fetch is out must judge the response that lands
failures.evidence: Red test 'inbox: an issue closed while the Inbox read is in flight drops its ask from the Inbox' in refresh-freshness.e2e.ts (f454e5b1ef47). It fails at head on chromium and iphone: the ask of the closed issue stays in the Inbox ([data-inbox-row] count 1, expected 0). It passes at base on both projects. Also red unit test 'a test of a read's data while a fetch is out runs on the response that lands, not the data it replaces' in query-refresh.test.ts (cbcf7310c171): starts [0, 1500] where [0, 1500, 2500] is expected. Cause found by reading: query-refresh.ts refreshQueries (222-233) runs `when` on the data being replaced whenever a fetch is out and data exists, so inboxRowsOf, pinnedRow, referencePanels and the document-summary rule can skip a refresh for good.

failures.evidence: Red test 'children: a child's priority write moves its active time in the open parent's Children tab within 2 s' in refresh-freshness.e2e.ts (f454e5b1ef47).
